description:
Welcome to the official The Second Arrow channel!

Learn to drop the second arrow of mental suffering through timeless Zen parables and mindfulness.
Clear, visual, research-backed explainers crafted for overthinkers, seekers of calm, and anyone navigating stress, grief, or emotional turbulence.

Core topics: Secular & classical Buddhist psychology, Zen parables, mindfulness & letting go.

#mindfulness #zen #buddhism #peace #meditation #mentalhealth
